blocks.markdown: The Mac CI correction is merged in [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183), after independent review and all required pre-merge checks. Checks on the resulting main version are running. A separate unsent-draft recovery repair passes local checks; review caught a remaining case where background completion can hide its recovery warning. That case is being corrected before publication.
Last refreshed: **20 October 2026 at 15:19 Europe/Tallinn**. This is a saved progress summary, not live activity.
# Current work

- **Completion and Undo checked:** [PR 182](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/182) is merged and all four required checks now pass on its resulting main version. It extends the existing desktop journey to confirm completion, verify its saved evidence, and undo that exact change. Actual Mac interaction remains separate.

- **Clearer grouped review controls:** [PR 179](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/179) is merged, and all four required checks now pass on the merged main version. Actual Mac control observation remains in the daily batch.

- **Writing proposal checked:** one bounded account test produced exactly the requested wording change as a pending proposal. The original note, captured feedback and unrelated note stayed unchanged. A test-harness failure before account contact was diagnosed and corrected first. Actual Mac Apply and Undo remain queued; no further generation is needed.

- **Unsent draft recovery repair:** the original first-comment/reopen test failed on old code and passes on the local candidate. Storage refusal and rollback checks, the full desktop suite, lint and a normal Mac build also passed. Independent review found one remaining warning-visibility issue after background completion; correction and a targeted recheck are pending. The repair is not published or merged.

- **More reliable export completion:** [PR181](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/181) is merged and all four required checks now pass on its resulting main version. The original Mac45-minute cancellation is preserved alongside the successful exact-source retry. Actual Mac export and broader durability observation remain separate.
# Completed improvements
- **One progress view and clearer development instructions:** merged in [PR 178](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/178), with all four required checks passing after merge.
- **Clearer feedback choices:** merged in [PR 176](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/176). Selected states were also observed through actual Mac controls on the qualified build.
- **More precise AI note reading:** merged in [PR 175](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/175). Note requests use exact identities, and reading reports identify truncation correctly.

- **Earlier reliability work:** worker identity, recovery coordination, notices, reference import, bounded correction, local editing and review feedback improvements are merged. Their detailed checks remain in the repository records.

- **Consistent imports across entry points:** the offline command-line-to-desktop check reused the same conversation and exact owner message, with one additional work attempt. Successful AI work and actual Mac input remain separate.

- **Mac CI investigation and cleanup:** missing cached build files and converter compilation dominate the inspected delay; converter test execution itself took about two seconds. Removed5.89GB of obsolete caches belonging to merged PR182, preserving all five main caches. The earlier cache’s disappearance remains unexplained. [Investigation and evidence](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/codex/agent-first-followthrough/docs/work/active/vacation-campaign/ci-cache-investigation.md).
# Next steps

1. Verify the required resulting-main checks for merged [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183). Finish the draft recovery warning correction and independent recheck before publishing that separate repair. The CI change retains every check, saves new caches only from main and gives Mac Core a bounded 60-minute allowance; no future speed benchmark is claimed.

2. During the consolidated **18:00 Europe/Tallinn** Mac session, exercise saving, reopening, backups, unsaved recovery, grouped-review controls and Apply/Undo of the saved writing proposal using synthetic data.
3. Continue useful Mac-first hardening within the existing campaign authorization and available allowance.
# Needs attention

**No decision is needed from you now.** PR 183 is merged with resulting-main checks pending. The draft repair remains gated on the identified warning correction and independent recheck. Optional Windows failures are retained. Actual Mac interaction stays in the 18:00 Tallinn batch; no owner data or live account call was used for these recovery tests.
# Detailed progress and sources
- [Latest published development overview](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/codex/agent-first-followthrough/docs/work/overview.md)
- [Overview on the integrated main branch](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/main/docs/work/overview.md)
- [Open pull requests](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pulls)
- [Campaign evidence on the development branch](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/codex/agent-first-followthrough/docs/work/active/vacation-campaign/evidence.md)

The repository task record remains authoritative. This Page is its remote summary; updates happen at meaningful campaign transitions, rather than through a live filesystem connection. GitHub links show their last published versions.

operations.markdown: The Mac CI correction is merged in [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183); checks on the resulting main version are running. The unsent-draft recovery repair is independently reviewed, passes local checks and is published in [PR 184](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/184), awaiting required automated checks. A small inactive-Project skill-control issue is being corrected separately.
Last refreshed: **20 October 2026 at 15:38 Europe/Tallinn**. This is a saved progress summary, not live activity.

- **Unsent draft recovery repair:** [PR 184](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/184) preserves typed drafts when the first passage comment creates a writing conversation. Both review findings are fixed: background work cannot hide the recovery warning, and dismissing it preserves a separate unseen error. Final desktop checks passed 340 tests with one existing ignored; storage safeguards, lint, production build and independent review also passed. Required hosted checks and actual Mac close/reopen remain pending.

1. Verify the required main checks for [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183) and exact-version checks for the separate [draft repair](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/184) before normal integration. Separately fix misleading skill Enable choices in inactive Projects; the underlying service already refuses these writes safely.

2. During the consolidated **18:00 Europe/Tallinn** Mac session, exercise ready saving/reopening, backup, recovery, grouped-review and saved-proposal Apply/Undo scenarios with synthetic data. Include the new unsent-draft close/reopen journey only on its matching reviewed and qualified build; defer excess scenarios beyond the bounded session.

**No decision is needed from you now.** PR 183 is merged with required main checks pending; PR 184 is reviewed and locally checked, with hosted checks running. Optional Windows failures remain recorded. Actual Mac interaction remains separate; no owner data or live account call was used for the draft repair.
